scientific_limitations: Global sufficiency does not imply necessity for each fixed matrix; two-site sharpness concerns the specified symmetric family; critical inverse-time law holds on an invariant antisymmetric line, not for arbitrary initial data. Non-sigmoid and nonautonomous models are outside scope.
title: Sharp mixing boundary for global homogeneity in sigmoid threshold networks
